  "text": "The Fed stopping after December (or reversing) by April has two causes with opposite effects on stocks: inflation cooling fast as oil falls (S&P up a few percent), or growth and markets cracking (S&P down around 10%). Kalshi prices a cut before July 2027 near 45%, which says the second is live. I weight them about evenly and put the S&P 1% below the baseline; the sign is the least certain figure in this row."
